hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd target
grep '^APPLICATION_CLIENT_SECRET=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2- > secret.txt
export appplication_uuid=`docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf --network=${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host} mysql mysql -N -e "SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(uuid) FROM auth.application where name='PICSURE';"`
# This UUID is currently a magic number of sorts, this will need to be parameterized to make this job portable export new_token_introspection_token=`java -jar generateJwt.jar secret.txt sub "PSAMA_APPLICATION|${appplication_uuid}" 365 day | grep -v "Generating"`
gateway_env=/usr/local/docker-config/gateway/gateway.env if grep -q '^TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=' "$gateway_env"; then sed -i "s|^TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=.*|TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=$new_token_introspection_token|" "$gateway_env" else printf '\nTOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=%s\n' "$new_token_introspection_token" >> "$gateway_env" fi echo "gateway.env updated -- recreate the gateway container (Deploy or Start PIC-SURE) to apply."
docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf --network=${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host} mysql mysql -e \ "update application set token='$new_token_introspection_token';" auth
